name: US500 NY30 Value Area + VWAP — unchanged gold transfer
authorization: User: try it on us100 and us500 too. Unchanged frozen Gold NY30 rules. No optimization or live changes.
broker: Isolated Exness-MT5Trial16 data; not the live terminal
lot_rounding: UP per canonical raw pipeline; actual risk can exceed 1%

fixed.profile_method: M1 HLC3 assigned to one price bin, weighted by tick_volume; proxy, not exchange volume-at-price

reversal: Previous post-10:00 M1 bar breaches opening range high/low. Track extreme for 15 minutes. A later M1 close inside VA, below upper/above lower VWAP band, still on the excursion side of VWAP -> fade next tick. SL beyond excursion extreme including signal bar. If price touches latest completed-M1 VWAP favorably after entry, move SL to actual fill (gross BE); no trailing.
continuation: M1 close crosses beyond both VA edge and same-direction VWAP band. Within next 10 M1 bars, retest the current closed-bar band, close back beyond band and VA edge with candle body in direction -> enter next tick. Cancel on close across VWAP. SL beyond retest candle extreme. No BE or trailing. Symmetric directions. Independent of reversal, not forced stop-and-reverse.
control: First M1 close crossing opening range boundary, without VP/VWAP filters or retest. Signal candle extreme stop; same 3R/sizing/session constraints; one per direction/day, max 2. Structural benchmark, not a matched randomized causal control.
arbitration: Reversal has priority if both engines signal on same bar. One attempt per engine/day; invalid or rejected first qualifying signal consumes attempt. Both engines maintain signals while another position is open but no entries then.

gate.beat_control: higher PF and return/maximum-equity-DD on both long windows
gate.data_caveat: Generated/mixed tick periods are not real-tick confirmation; no promotion without full coverage
gate.selection: Only eligible versions ranked by minimum 3y/5y return/max-equity-DD; ties lower DD then fewer rules. Short windows diagnostic, no retuning.

schedule: Smoke all four; Model 1 screen 3y/5y all four; Model 4 requested-mode confirmation 6m/1y/3y/5y all four. Explicitly disclose actual real-tick start and mixed coverage.
